core_obligations: Identify the target: the sum of copies of the injective hull of the residue field is the injective hull of the corresponding sum of residue fields, which is the maximal-ideal torsion of the module (proof lines 1031-1034)
Embed: since that torsion is an essential submodule, any map injective on it has zero kernel (proof lines 1035-1038)
proof_roadmap: E^{⊕n} 是 κ^{⊕n} = M[m] 的内射壳 ⇒ 存在 M → E^{⊕n} 在 M[m] 上单。
M 是 m-幂挠 ⇒ M[m] ⊂ M 本质（由 essential-extension 的判据）⇒ 该映射核为 0。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a module annihilated by a power of the maximal ideal embeds into a finite sum of copies of the injective hull of the residue field (author lemma at source lines 1022-1029, label lemma-torsion-submodule-sum-injective-hulls). The proof (source lines 1031-1039) identifies the target as the injective hull of the maximal-ideal torsion of the module and concludes injectivity of the map from essentialness of that torsion (proof lines 1031-1038). The essentialness step is the substance. H3.
